caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, rendered in shades of light blue and gray. The bonnet features a rounded, quilted crown with a diamond pattern and a prominent brim that flares outwards on both sides. The outer surface of the bonnet is light blue, while the inner lining is quilted with a gray and light blue diamond pattern. A band of black lace or trim outlines the edge of the bonnet's brim and crown. At the back of the bonnet, there are long, flowing blue ribbons or ties. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the bonnet, which is centered in the composition.
title: Opera Hood
